title: Centred smooth-section coordinates and their conormal monomials
statement:
Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme (one admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings), let $d\geq0$, and let $g:V\to S$ be smooth, separated and of finite type of pure relative dimension $d$, with a closed section $s:S\hookrightarrow V$, $g s=1_S$.
There is a Zariski open cover by affine $S_i=\operatorname{Spec}R_i\subseteq S$ and affine open neighbourhoods $U_i=\operatorname{Spec}B_i\subseteq V\times_SS_i$ containing $s(S_i)$, with separated etale $S_i$-maps $e_i:U_i\to\mathbf A^d_{S_i}$ carrying $s$ to zero, such that $e_i^{-1}(0)=s(S_i)$ scheme-theoretically. Writing $P_i=R_i[x_1,\ldots,x_d]$ and $J_i=(x_1,\ldots,x_d)$, the induced $P_i\to B_i$ is etale and flat, $I_i=J_iB_i$ is the section ideal, and $B_i/I_i=R_i$ by the section augmentation. The sequence of images of $x_1,\ldots,x_d$ is regular: multiplication by $x_j$ is injective modulo its predecessors. The empty sequence is allowed for $d=0$. Moreover, with $\mathcal I$ the ideal sheaf of $s(S)$ and $\mathcal E=\mathcal I/\mathcal I^2$ regarded on $S$, $s$ is a regular immersion of codimension $d$, $\mathcal E$ is locally free of rank $d$, and the canonical multiplication map
$$\operatorname{Sym}_{\mathcal O_S}(\mathcal E)\xrightarrow{\sim}\bigoplus_{m\geq0}\mathcal I^m/\mathcal I^{m+1}$$
is an isomorphism. On each chart its degree-$m$ map sends a basis monomial in $[x_j]$ to the class of the same monomial in $I_i^m/I_i^{m+1}$; these identifications commute with restriction.
The scheme, morphism, algebra and coefficient notation and the specified comparison maps are those of [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], [def-weil-proper-morphism], [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-weil-etale-morphism], [def-sbc-affine-space], [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra], [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence].
